args.fix: Replaced read-modify-write with atomic in-place UPDATEs: deposit uses UPDATE ... SET balance = balance + %s, withdraw uses UPDATE ... SET balance = balance - %s WHERE balance >= %s and maps rowcount 0 to unknown-account vs InsufficientFunds. The row lock from the UPDATE serializes concurrent writers on the same account without blocking other accounts.
args.root_cause: Lost update: deposit/withdraw did SELECT balance then UPDATE to a computed value with no locking. Two concurrent transactions read the same balance and the second overwrote the first, so some successful operations never affected the balance. Reconciliation (balance vs sum of successful ops) therefore drifted with no errors logged.

text: Fix accepted. Lost-update race in `deposit`/`withdraw` (SELECT then UPDATE with no lock) replaced with atomic `UPDATE ... SET balance = balance ± amount` (conditional on `balance >= amount` for withdraws), preserving single-threaded behavior while serializing concurrent writers per-row.
